column3: With respect to the Domain at Town Centre Mortgage Loan (6.1%), the borrower sponsor, Fortress Investment Group LLC, or its affiliates have been involved in various mortgage defaults, including a loan secured by a retail condominium located in New York City that was transferred to special servicing following a September 2022 maturity default. The borrower sponsor and special servicer have agreed to a loan modification that extends the loan term and involves an A/B note split.
